diff --git a/skills/do-jira-task/SKILL.md b/skills/do-jira-task/SKILL.md

evals.expected_output: An omit verdict with a one-sentence reason — the diff only repairs relative links, so no reader can do or see anything new — and no draft.
expectations: The reply is an omit verdict: it opens with 'omit' followed by a reason
The reason names what changed (links or paths were corrected) and states that it has no consequence for readers or that no skill behaves differently
No Telegram post is drafted, not even as an alternative or an 'in case you want one anyway'
Nothing is described as sent to or saved in Telegram

diff --git a/.claude/skills/telegram-git-diff/SKILL.md b/.claude/skills/telegram-git-diff/SKILL.md
--- a/.claude/skills/telegram-git-diff/SKILL.md

@@ -22,6 +22,11 @@
    - If the working-tree diff is empty, inspect the latest commit.
-2. Inspect the diff and relevant surrounding code.
-3. Draft one post.
+2. If this run is a library increment, read the increment's issue file too. The issue
+   file supplies intent; the diff stays the source of truth for what changed.
+3. Inspect the diff and relevant surrounding code.
+4. Decide whether a post is warranted. If not, return an omit verdict and stop here.
+5. Draft one post.
@@ -60,0 +66,12 @@
+## The bar for declining
+
+Not every change earns a post. When the diff has no consequence for anyone reading the
+channel - a link fix, a path rename, a typo - say so instead of forcing prose out of it.
+
+When declining, return an omit verdict and nothing else:
+
+    omit - <one sentence naming what changed and why it has no audience consequence>
evals.expected_output: A draft post in the default Update register, in Russian, about the skill gaining the ability to decline — returned in a fenced text block.
expectations: The reply is a drafted post, not an omit verdict
The post is returned inside a fenced code block
The post is written in Russian
The post is one to four short paragraphs of prose with no bullet list, no emoji headline and no hashtags
The post says the skill can now decline to write a post, or reads the issue file for intent — a change evidenced by the diff
The post does not claim a release, deployment, or measured improvement the diff does not show
No repository file path appears in the post
